message.content:
A refined wool-blend knit tunic in camel, straight cut falling to the hip, color #C19A6B.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers in heavy twill fabric, tapered length hitting just above the ankle, color #3E3F42.
Loafers made of smooth leather with a slight sheen, low block heel for comfort during the day, color #8D7B68.
A thin silk scarf tied loosely at the neckline in autumnal orange, color #E85D04.

This outfit works because the camel knit adds warmth and texture suitable for an 18 °C autumn day without being too heavy for daylight hours. The wide-leg trousers maintain a professional yet comfortable silhouette appropriate for a neat office dress code while allowing ease of movement throughout the workday. Completing the look with leather loafers grounds the ensemble in polished simplicity, avoiding any outer layer since the temperature remains mild enough to stay comfortable.
